summary: Retested backend + frontend after iteration_1 fixes, added production hosting and Wisp probe regression tests, and validated Render packaging artifacts.

ui_bugs.issue: Bug still reproducible: 2+3 then ans+2 from keypad does not submit as valid next expression/result (history-result-1 never appears; expression shows validation error).

integration_issues.issue: Both Wisp endpoints are live and direct /web loads example.com with connected iframe, but UI run did not expose deterministic endpoint-switch path (attempts panel remains empty while endpoint 1 stays connected).

issues: Console accessibility warning repeated: AlertDialogContent requires description for screen readers after description removal.

action_items: Fix remaining calculator ans chaining behavior so ans+2 evaluates and persists to history as expected.
Add accessible dialog description strategy (visible or visually hidden) to remove AlertDialog a11y warning while preserving requested UX copy changes.
If endpoint failover proof is required in UI evidence, add test hook/telemetry to force endpoint 1 disconnect and expose connection-2 transition in attempts panel.
critical_code_review_comments: Initial regression run skipped 100% tests due wrong frontend/.env lookup in conftest path (fixed to parents[2]); keep this stable to avoid false green/false skip runs.
backend/.env in workspace contains live provider key material; ensure no secrets are committed or exposed in repository artifacts.
Render build remains large (1.22 MB chunk); not blocking but still worth splitting for production performance.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary chat sessions and status rows through live API calls during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Current backend suite passes fully (13 tests): core APIs, live OpenRouter multi-turn/session persistence, production SPA hosting with SERVE_FRONTEND=true, and direct handshake checks for both Wisp endpoints without subprotocol. Frontend confirms exact title, favicon 200, compatibility route /testing/kentucky/scientific works, /library and /notes function, 2048 iframe loads, /web connects and renders proxied example.com with sandbox-limited third-party resource/CORS warnings. LeaveConfirmation no blocker.reset runtime error observed; only Radix accessibility warning remains.
rca of the issue: ans bug RCA: after first submit, inserting ans then +2 leaves expression in invalid state ('Check your expression') and no second history entry; issue likely remains in math-field token composition/selection cursor handling for ans token insertion sequence. Accessibility warning RCA: LeaveConfirmation intentionally removed dialog description, but Radix AlertDialogContent expects aria-describedby content and logs warning each open.
